offering_description.value: Remanufactures and supplies automotive aftermarket replacement parts such as alternators, starters, wheel hub assemblies, brake calipers and brake parts, and also makes test equipment for the auto industry. Sells mainly to large auto parts retailers and warehouse distributors in North America, using returned used parts (cores) as feedstock.

primary_products.value: remanufactured alternators and starters; wheel hub assemblies and bearings; brake calipers and master cylinders; turbochargers; diagnostic and test equipment

customer_segment.value: B2B: large auto parts retailers, warehouse distributors, and OEM/dealer service networks

end_markets.value: automotive aftermarket; vehicle repair and maintenance; automotive testing equipment

revenue_model.value: product sales: remanufactured and new replacement parts sold to retailers and distributors, including core-related charges

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: remanufactures used cores and purchased components into replacement parts, sold to auto parts retailers and distributors

geography_served.value: North America: US, Canada and Mexico customers, with manufacturing in Mexico, Malaysia, China and Tijuana, some other international sales

specialization.value: related lines: rotating electrical, wheel-end, brake and turbocharger parts, plus test equipment, all for automotive aftermarket

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: major auto parts retail chains such as AutoZone, O'Reilly and Advance; distributors / dealers: warehouse distributors and OEM dealer networks; direct sales: test equipment sold directly to vehicle and component manufacturers
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, trade and tariff rules apply to manufacturing and cross-border sourcing, product safety standards for brake parts

notes: Manufacturing locations and exact product mix may be slightly outdated; the geography detail should be checked. Customer concentration in a few retailers is high.
